title: Control Malfunctions & Flight Instrument Anomalies, by Captain Warren VanderBurgh.
summary: An American Airlines training video by Captain Warren VanderBurgh on control malfunctions and flight instrument anomalies. It discusses real incidents such as runaway trim and instrument failures and how crews should respond.
why: Cited in aviation threads as a gripping primary-source account of incidents like stabilizer trim moving without the pilot's knowledge.

quote.text: There's an engaging account of this incident in an American Airlines training seminar that's now on Youtube
